work.question: Am I employed or self-employed?
work.answer: Employed. You're on our payroll, we deduct your tax and National Insurance, and you get a payslip.

work.question: Do I have to take shifts?
work.answer: No. Take the work that suits you.

work.question: Do I need experience?
work.answer: For bar and silver service, yes. For runners and porters, no.

hire/bar-staff.question: Can your bar staff work to our cocktail list?
hire/bar-staff.answer: Yes. Send it with your enquiry and it goes into the brief.

hire/bar-staff.question: How late can the bar run?
hire/bar-staff.answer: As late as your licence allows. Give us the real finish time.

hire/bar-staff.question: Can you cover a shift at short notice?
hire/bar-staff.answer: Ask whatever the date. We take a lot of overflow work.

hire/kitchen-porters.question: What does a kitchen porter cover?
hire/kitchen-porters.answer: Wash-up through service, bins and waste, and the clear down. Tell us about any prep.

hire/kitchen-porters.question: Can you cover early starts and long days?
hire/kitchen-porters.answer: Yes. Give us the real call and finish times.

hire/kitchen-porters.question: Can we book the same porters every week?
hire/kitchen-porters.answer: Where the pattern is regular, we send the same people.

hire/production-catering.question: Can you cover a 5am call time?
hire/production-catering.answer: Yes. Send the call sheet times when you enquire.

hire/production-catering.question: Can we have the same crew for the whole shoot?
hire/production-catering.answer: That's the aim. Tell us the shoot dates up front.

hire/production-catering.question: How are cooks and chefs charged?
hire/production-catering.answer: Quoted individually, by section and unit size.

hire/waiting-staff.question: How many waiting staff do we need?
hire/waiting-staff.answer: Tell us guest numbers, service style and timings. We'll recommend a team.

hire/waiting-staff.question: Do they know the running order before they arrive?
hire/waiting-staff.answer: Yes. Send it and it goes into their brief.

hire/waiting-staff.question: Can we ask for the same staff again?
hire/waiting-staff.answer: Yes, by name. Anyone who wasn't right won't be sent again.

hire/weddings.question: Our venue is dry hire. Can you staff the whole day?
hire/weddings.answer: Yes, dry hire is a lot of what we do. Build the team the day needs.

hire/weddings.question: How many staff will our wedding need?
hire/weddings.answer: Send guest numbers, service style and running order. We'll recommend a team.

hire/weddings.question: Who do the staff take direction from?
hire/weddings.answer: Whoever you tell us: planner, caterer, venue or you.

special-events/christmas.question: Our party runs past midnight. How does that work?
special-events/christmas.answer: Tell us the real finish time when you enquire. The late hours are then in the quote, not a surprise on the invoice.

special-events/christmas.question: How late can we book Christmas staff?
special-events/christmas.answer: Ask whatever the date. The more notice we have, the more choice you get.

special-events/christmas.question: How many staff do we need?
special-events/christmas.answer: Tell us the guest number, the service style and the timings. We recommend a team for your party rather than a ratio.

special-events/halloween.question: How far ahead should we book?
special-events/halloween.answer: Now booking 23–24 and 30–31 October. Ask anyway and we'll tell you what's still possible.

special-events/halloween.question: Do you supply the costumes?
special-events/halloween.answer: Yours styled by us, or sourced and hired for the booking. We don't hold a costume store, so raise the look early.

special-events/halloween.question: How scary is “scary”?
special-events/halloween.answer: Your call, agreed before the event. Scare level, contact, age range and venue limits all go in the brief.

special-events/halloween.question: Can we book one or two people?
special-events/halloween.answer: Yes, two themed hosts is a normal booking. The {{MIN_HOURS}}-hour minimum still applies.
